units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 27:1">Kel. XXVII, 1</cite> <he>כל שאין לו ת׳ וכ׳</he> earthen vessels which have no inside (receptacle), have no back, i.e. their back is not susceptible of levitical uncleanness.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 25:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>כלי שנטמאו … לא נטמא תוֹכוֹ</he> if the outside of a vessel has become unclean, its inside is not affected thereby.
<cite ref="Yoma 72b:9">Yoma 72ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01156"><he>בַּר</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תּוֹכוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Niddah 45b:43">Nidd. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>ת׳ זמן</he> within the period (during the year of developing puberty); <cite ref="Bava Batra 155b:5">B. Bath. 155ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 5a:7">Ib. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>פרעתיך בת׳ זמני</he> I paid thee within my appointed time (before the debt was due).
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 7:5">Dem. VII, 5</cite> <he>בת׳ ביתו</he> in his house.
Kil. I, 8 לת׳ האבטיח into a melon; a. v. fr.–ת׳ כדי דיבור, v. דַּי.—מִתּ׳ immediately from, through, because of.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:1">Ber. V, 1</cite> <he>מת׳ כובד ראש</he> in a mood of humility, v. <cite ref="K00184"><he>כּוֹבֶד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 31a:5">Ib. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>אין … לא מת׳ דין וכ׳</he> you must not rise for prayer immediately after giving judgment, or after an undecided discussion &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 31a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>מת׳ עצבות</he> from a mood of grief.
<cite ref="Pesachim 50b:5">Pes. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>מת׳ שלא לשמה</he>, v. <cite ref="U01408"><he>שֵׁם</he></cite>; <cite ref="Nazir 23b">Naz. 23ᵇ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shevuot 32b:13">Shebu. 32ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מת׳ שאינו יכול לישבע וכ׳</he> because he cannot make oath, he must pay.

<cite ref="Beitzah 12a">Bets. 12ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מת׳ שהותרה הוצאה וכ׳</he> since carrying for an immediate need (on the Holy Bay) has once been permitted, it has also been permitted for a less immediate need; a. v. fr.
